title: verify-capture-geometry.py (the r2-mandated rendered-geometry check) is wired into nothing — 0% automated coverage of the capture pipeline
evidence: scripts/verify-capture-geometry.py docstring: 'endpoint-vs-node-center geometric check to the capture pipeline"). For the / slice-1 fixture (3 nodes in a row), the check proves the RENDERED roads / connect the RENDERED node centers:' — but the full gate list in scripts/local-ci.sh ends at: '"ENGINE:PPProbe commandlet (headless spine probe + negative-args leg)|scripts/run-tests-headless.sh --probe --json-out docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json && scripts/run-tests-headless.sh --probe-negative"' and '"ENGINE:Golden compare (PPProbe vs standalone vs docs/goldens/ + mismatch self-test)|scripts/compare-golden.sh && scripts/compare-golden.sh --self-test"'. Repo-wide grep for 'verify-capture-geometry' (scripts/, docs/, Config/, Source/, docs/agent-playbook.md) returns only the script's own docstring/usage lines — zero callers.
detail: The r1/r2 blockers (road anchor, dot offset) shipped in RENDERED output because no automated check looked at pixels. The countermeasure script exists but no gate, playbook step, or script ever invokes it — the check is dead code and the rendered-geometry regression class stays unguarded.
recommended_fix: Wire it into the gate list (e.g. gate 8 'capture geometry' over a committed fixture frame; PIL-dependency fail-loud) or into the documented MCP capture loop in docs/agent-playbook.md, and run it once green in the PR.

title: v2 serialization byte-pin covers only the empty-collections form — populated topology/flow/log section writers have no byte-level pin on either runner
evidence: PP_DeterminismTests.cpp: 'PP::FSimState S; / S.Initialize(7); / PP::Step(S, 1); / uint8_t Buffer[4096]; / const size_t N = PP::SerializeState(S, Buffer, sizeof(Buffer));' — spine_check.cpp pins the same fresh state: 'CHECK(N == 98, "v2 fresh-state serialized size must be 98");'. Both callers serialize bare Initialize+Step(1) states (all sections empty). The per-entry writers (PP_Sim.h: 'for (const FPacket &P : State.Flow.Packets)' and the node/pipe/demand/log loops) are only reached transitively via StateHash's opaque byte stream — no test pins the populated wire layout (field order/offsets inside entries).
detail: The PR's headline v2 re-bless adds variable-length sections, but only the empty-form layout is byte-pinned. A field-order bug inside an entry would hash consistently on all three surfaces, pass every 3-way compare after re-bless, and corrupt the documented ODN-11 wire format silently.
recommended_fix: Add one populated-state pin on both surfaces: serialize the golden scenario mid-run (nodes/pipes/packets/log entries present) and CHECK the per-entry offsets/sizes against the documented SCHEMA.md layout.

title: compare-golden --self-test corrupts only 2 of 18 keys — the missing-key branch and the engine-probe leg of the negative path are untested
evidence: The corruption is: "doc['state_hash'] = '0000000000000000' / doc['flow_summary']['score'] = 999" — while the untested negative branch is: 'va="$(resolve_key "$k" "$a")" || { echo "  key $k missing in $a"; bad=1; continue; }' (and the engine-probe compare path never gets a self-test).
detail: A regression in the missing-key detection path (e.g. resolve_key succeeding on absent keys, or a KeyError being swallowed) would false-green the gate; the self-test only proves the corrupted-value branch fires.
recommended_fix: Extend the self-test with a key-deletion case (pop a key from the copy) asserting the compare fails with the 'key ... missing' message.

title: PPProbe routing-dump slot→node-id label remap is unasserted — the exact r2 label-mix bug class can regress silently
evidence: The dump builds labels via: 'const uint32_t FromId = State.Topology.NodeId[From]; / const uint32_t DstId = State.Topology.NodeId[Dst]; / FString Line = FString::Printf(TEXT("  routing[node%u -> node%u]: "), FromId, DstId);' — nothing asserts these lines; the golden JSON pins only counts: '"forwarding_summary":{"reachable_pairs":%d,"total_hops":%d}' (derived from HopCount, not the printed labels). The in-code comment itself records the prior bug: 'the dump mixed slot indices and node ids'.
detail: Display-only surface, but the r2 review caught exactly this label bug by eye; a reverted remap (slot ids printed again) passes every gate. Low impact since the load-bearing numbers are pinned 3-way.
recommended_fix: Factor the dump-line formatting into a pure helper (topology + table -> lines) and pin one line in the UE tests, or grep-assert 'node' labels in the probe log leg.
